verdict.rationale: Serving embedding models is a fair question for an on-device and cloud inference SDK, so the axis applies. However, the evidence documents only LLM generation, STT, TTS, VAD, diarization, VLM and image-generation APIs, and nowhere mentions an embeddings API or retrieval/search support. The OpenAI-compatible Cloud endpoint is not stated to expose embeddings, so it cannot be credited here.
